subject: CPPO activation: ops snapshot & reseller QA for CloudResell
messages:
From: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: activation checklist and PO flow for CPPO (CloudResell)

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks for taking this — we're preparing the paperwork to get our Channel Private Offer (CPPO) live for a pilot customer next week. To avoid back-and-forth with AWS, can you confirm the precise evidence bundle and the preferred PO/invoice routing? Specifically:

- Which entity name and EIN should the PO reference for Redwood (we have multiple entities on file)?
- What are the minimal evidence items AWS expects pre-activation (SOC2 report, KMS summary, technical certs)?
- Do you have a preferred contact at AWS Marketplace for the activation team?

We're attaching a stub of our EIN/W9 for your ops team to validate.

Attachments: reseller_requirements_EIN_stub.pdf (stub)

Appreciate a quick turnaround — pilot goes live 06/06.

Best,
Maya Patel
Head of Marketplace Ops
CloudResell Ltd
ops@cloudresell.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: activation checklist and PO flow for CPPO (CloudResell)

Thanks Maya — good timing. Short answer up front: we can enable CPPO for your pilot by EOW if we get the evidence and PO details by EOD Tuesday. High-level checklist below; I'm copying Soojin (partner ops) and Ben (sales) to own discrete items.

Mutual action plan (recommended):
- CloudResell: Send signed PO (entity + EIN) via DocuSign and confirm billing email for invoices.
- Redwood (Soojin): Validate reseller entity mapping against AWS account and produce CPPO evidence bundle.
- Redwood (Ben): Confirm pricing SKU and entitlement SKU mapping for the CPPO catalog entry.
- AWS Marketplace: activation queue (we'll raise the request once evidence is attached).

Evidence matrix (what we typically need pre-activation):
- Reseller W9 / EIN (you provided stub; need full PDF)
- Customer-facing pricing sheet and SKUs for the offer
- High-level data flow diagram (one page)
- Security attestations: SOC2 type II report OR summary + KMS/HSM statement
- Contact person for invoices (email + AP terms)

I've attached the evidence matrix template we use internally — fill the columns and return.

Attachments: cpop_activation_evidence_matrix.xlsx (template)

Ben / Soojin — can you call out any additional AWS-specific forms we should expect? Ben, please confirm if we can accept CloudResell's standard PO (net-30) or if sales needs to negotiate payment terms.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-30T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: activation checklist and PO flow for CPPO (CloudResell)

Thanks — quick notes:
- Pricing & SKU: I reviewed the draft pricing. For the pilot we can accept CloudResell's standard SKU mapping; I'll update the CPPO metadata once we have the official PO line items.
- Terms: Standard is net-30; if CloudResell needs net-45 we can discuss but it may delay activation.
- AWS contact: I'll loop in our AWS partner rep in a follow-up once Soojin confirms the evidence set.

Propose a 30-min sync tomorrow at 10am PT to walk through the matrix and confirm DocuSign flow. I'll send a calendar invite.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Marketplace
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Maya Patel <ops@cloudresell.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-31T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: activation checklist and PO flow for CPPO (CloudResell)

Thanks team — attaching our full W9 and a compliance contact. A couple quick clarifications:

- Entity for PO: CloudResell Ltd (EIN: 13-XXXXXXX) — we'll have legal sign the PO and send via DocuSign.
- Invoice routing: please confirm whether Redwood wants invoices sent to billing@cloudresell.com (our AP) or to invoices@cloudresell-partners.com (centralized partner AP). We prefer the latter for consolidated reporting.
- Security evidence: we'll attach SOC2 summary and KMS key usage statement to the evidence matrix.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded/packet/0a1b2c3d
Attachments: CloudResell_W9.pdf

We accepted Ben's 10am PT slot — expect the calendar invite.

Maya
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: AWS Marketplace <aws-marketplace@amazon.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, CloudResell Ops <ops@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-31T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: activation checklist and PO flow for CPPO (CloudResell)

Looping in AWS Marketplace for visibility so they can pre-assign the activation ticket once we upload the evidence bundle. Ben and Soojin will attach the completed matrix + signed PO after the call.

Action items after today's sync (owners):
- CloudResell (Maya): final signed PO into DocuSign by EOD today (done) — confirm billing address and AP email.
- Soojin: validate CloudResell entity against AWS account and upload evidence bundle to AWS portal (ETA: today 6pm PT).
- Ben: finalize CPPO SKU mapping and confirm offer configuration (ETA: tonight).
- Vanessa: escalate to AWS if activation queue hasn't been processed by 06/03; prepare temporary fallback (direct invoice routing) if needed.

I'll follow up with a short status update once AWS confirms assignment.

Thanks all — clean run so far.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
